name: Spiritual Warfare
overview: Spiritual warfare is a tangible reality in which believers confront a powerful enemy opposed to God's purposes, yet Scripture assures divine protection and victory. God promises to defeat enemies and shield His people, as seen in His power to make foes flee and nullify weapons formed against His servants. Christ grants believers authority over the enemy's power, enabling them to stand firm by putting on God's full armor. This battle is fought with confidence in God's grace, righteousness, and protection, securing victory through faith and the assurance of His presence.
